sdlc.justification:
The chosen SDLC is the **Agile–V-Model hybrid** with a score of 94/100, which aligns perfectly with the SRS profile of a high-regulation, high-security finance project requiring both numerical stability and iterative delivery.

**Alignment Justification:**
1.  **Regulatory & Formal Verification (High Priority):** The SRS contains multiple 'Regulatory' and 'Security' requirements (R3, R4, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10) with explicit failure consequences (account freezes, non-compliance status).

workflow.activities: Conduct preliminary threat modeling based on R9 (Live OTP) and R3 (Digital KYC) per RBI life-cycle standards. Select Hybrid approach: V-Mode
workflow.roles: Project Manager, Compliance Lead, Security Architect
workflow.deliverables: Hybrid SDLC Charter (defining V-Mode for Reg items, Agile for others), Preliminary Threat Model
workflow.gate: Compliance: Ensure 'Regulatory criticality' factor is accepted as 'High' with documented exception handling plan.

workflow.activities: Extract and freeze all fixed regulatory logic into a baseline specification. Define exact numeric thresholds (15%, 50k, 40k, 60k, 5 mins) as
workflow.deliverables: FROG (Functional Requirements Outline Guide) or SRS Appendix for Fixed Requirements, Traceability to
workflow.gate: Human Approval: Regulatory Officer to sign off on fixed numeric constraints and compliance mapping.

workflow.activities: Iterate on flexible parameters and UI/UX flows. Each sprint will cover a specific requirement cluster.
workflow.roles: Product Owner, UI/UX Designer, Backend Developers, QA
workflow.deliverables: User Stories (User Story Mapping), Spike Reports (for complex integrations like GPS/R1), Sprint Back
workflow.gate: Human Approval: Stakeholder (Low availability) review at end of each sprint for 'Definition of Done'.

workflow.activities: Execute formal verification on fixed requirements immediately after code commit. Perform Unit Testing (boundary values for R1/R2),
workflow.deliverables: Verification Vignette (Evidence of correct behavior), Unit Test Reports, Static Analysis Reports
workflow.gate: Automated Gate: Tests must pass; Formal Proof required for R6/R7 logic.

workflow.activities: Implement SAST/DAST for R9 (OTP expiry), R4 (Watermark integrity). Integrate penetration testing for remote KYC.
workflow.deliverables: Security Assessment Report, SAST/DAST Results, Penetration Test Report
workflow.gate: Security Gate: R9 must pass OTP validation checks; R4 watermark must be cryptographically verified.

workflow.activities: Build the audit trail for R10 ensuring immutability (12-month retention). Map all decisions to authorized officers (R3, R8).
workflow.deliverables: Audit Log Schema, Retention Policy Document, Access Control Matrix
workflow.gate: Compliance Gate: Verify 12-month retention policy and officer authorization logs against RBI guidelines.

item.text: Done. **Agile–V-Model hybrid** fits best: 6 phases, each with an exit gate tied to requirement IDs.
